title: ULI-NChIP assay protocol
protocol: Wash protein A/G coated magnetic beads twice with ice cold ChIP Buffer for each IP.
Resuspend the washed beads in ChIP Buffer to match the initial concentration of the stock.
Aliquot 90 μl of ChIP Buffer per IP into a new tube.
Add 10 μl of pre-washed Protein A/G-beads per IP tube, making up a total volume of 100 μl per IP.
Add specific antibody and control antibodies to each IP tube.
Incubate the tubes at 4 rpm on a rotating wheel for at least 2 hours at 4°C.
Seed cells in 20 μl Nuclei Extraction Buffer.
Invert tubes gently several times, then centrifuge for 5 minutes at 4000 rpm in 4°C.
Discard 10 μl of supernatant and keep another 10 μl with the nucleus.
Prepare MNase Master Mix.
Add 40 μl MNase Master Mix to each sample by pipetting or gentle mixing.
Proceed at room temperature (25°C) for 10 minutes.
Add 5.5 μl MNase Stop Solution, mix well by gentle mixing.
Add 5.5 μl Nuclear Break Buffer into the tube and mix well by gentle mixing.
Add Complete ChIP Buffer to make 100 μl sheared chromatin for each IP and 10 μl for input.
Briefly spin the tube containing the antibody-coated beads to bring down liquid caught inside the lid.
Place tubes in the ice-cold magnetic rack, wait for 1 min. Discard the supernatant. Keep the antibody-coated beads.
Add 100 μl of diluted sheared chromatin to each IP tube and keep 10 μl of diluted chromatin as input at 4°C or store at -20°C.
Invert the tubes several times to make sure beads are resuspended.
Incubate samples at 4°C under constant rotation on a rotator at 40 rpm for 2 hours up to overnight.
Brief spin the tubes to bring down the liquid caught on the lid.
Place the tubes into the magnetic rack, wait 1 min and discard the buffer.
Wash twice using 100 μl of ice-cold Low Salt Wash Buffer and twice using High Salt Wash Buffer.
Add 100 μl Hot Elution Buffer to the beads and 90 μl Elution buffer to the input and transfer them to a new tube.
Place the strips on a magnetic rack.
Let sit for 1 minute.
Transfer the strips to a PhaseLock tube.
Briefly spin the PhaseLock tube to bring down the agarose.
Add 100 μl of DNA and an equal volume (100 μl) of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol into the PhaseLock tube.
Mix well by vortexing.
Spin at 13,000g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.
Add one-tenth volume of NaOAc and LPA.
Add 2.5 times the volume of ice-cold 100% EtOH.
Mix well by vortexing.
Put the tubes at -20°C for precipitation for 30 minutes up to overnight.
Centrifuge DNA at 13,000g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and add 1 ml of 70% EtOH.
Let the tube sit for 5 minutes to allow salt dissolution.
Then centrifuge at 13,000g for 5 minutes at 4°C to attach the pellet to the bottom.
Remove the ethanol and let the pellet dry for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 30 μl of DNA elution buffer.
